sources.finding: Node 24.12 V8 emits samples with node IDs and signed integer differences between adjacent sample timestamps.
V8 records samples only at or after profile start; insertion order is not explicitly sorted here.
DevTools reconstructs absolute timestamps by summing deltas, then sorts samples paired with their timestamps.

limitations: The failed hosted run did not retain its raw profile. The exact delta/node at the failing sample is unavailable. Native local diagnostic did not reproduce the intermittent failure in 100 profiles; signed-delta regression fixtures reproduce the old validator defect deterministically.
